notes: Access: direct curl_cffi (impersonate chrome124) to www.frontgate.com, 200 OK throughout, no block encountered. Counts from the site's own Unbxd API proxy (UnbxdAPI?categoryId=<id>...) -> numberOfProducts, double-verified with a boundary test (unbxdStart=N-1 -> 1 item, unbxdStart=N -> 0 items) for every row below; all matched exactly. Discovery: pulled the site's own full nav/category JSON tree (/JSONAPIs?module=categories, ~1600 nodes) and located every categoryTitle containing New Arrivals / New In / Just In / Just Arrived / Latest / What's New / Recently Added / New Collection - only 'New Arrivals' occurs, in two structurally distinct places. (1) A site-wide 'New Arrivals' PLP (categoryId 144279, /whats-new/new/, landingPage ProductGridView) sitting under the top 'New & Trending' mega-menu; its own child tiles (Outdoor/Furniture/Bed & Bath/Tabletop & Entertaining, categoryIds 197656/144282/198258/145232) are visual river tiles only and all report numberOfProducts=0 via the site's own API - confirmed empty and dropped per the zero-product rule, so only the parent site-wide listing is kept. (2) Each major department has its own separate 'Discover > New Arrivals' PLP with a distinct URL path and distinct, genuinely different (non-subset) product counts: Outdoor, Furniture, Bed & Bath, Lighting & Decor, Rugs & Pillows, Tabletop & Entertaining, and Holiday Decor each expose their own /<department>/discover/new-arrivals/ (or /outdoor/discover/new-outdoor/) listing. These 7 department pages sum to 791 products, more than the 637 in the site-wide listing, confirming they are not a simple department split of the same 637-item pool but a separately curated 'new to this department' feed - kept all 8 as distinct rows per the brief's 'genuinely different listings -> keep both' rule; overlap between them and the site-wide listing is expected and not an error. Explicitly did NOT include 'New to Clearance' (/sale/outlet/new-arrivals/, categoryId 98159) here even though its URL slug says 'new-arrivals' - its own categoryTitle is 'New to Clearance' and it lives inside the Clearance/Outlet tree (recently-marked-down clearance stock), so it is recorded in the Clearance file instead, not here. Checked for 'Collection'-style pages that might be mislabeled New Arrivals (per the brief's Collection-page test): none of the New-Arrivals-adjacent nodes use 'Collection' wording, and the one page that IS a themed/campaign hub with 'New' in a name near it ('Trending' -> /whats-new/seasonal-favorites/, a seasonal-campaign hub with Fall Decor / a designer collab / outdoor furniture sets as children, landingPage CategoryLandingView1) is not a New Arrivals candidate at all - it's an editorial seasonal hub, not evaluated here.
